I read them against the threat model: prefix-cache and SSD tier text (T-041), Nemotron Super local owner, media admission and charging bounds, logprobs, and refusal-line logging (Invariant 10, content-free). None of it shows a regression or an invalidated assumption. If that PR also changes scheduling, a reviewer should confirm that nonzero decode steps cannot starve prefill, or that prefill fairness cannot be abused for denial of service. This documentation-only unit gives no evidence of that, so I raise no finding.
